problem: 30 green suites, 12,927 lines. Eleven suites test runner subcommands directly and 22 spawn fc. Under the seam their spec nodes retire.

questions.text: What happens to the testbench suites whose spec nodes retire?
questions.why: The test-builder writes this run's checks fresh from v2. The old suites are either a regression floor for kept leaves, or dead weight the lock defends.

options.value: Kept only where they cover a kept leaf or hook; suites for retired nodes are deleted in this run; the test-builder writes v2's checks into the run's checks folder and may reuse testbench fixtures and lib.
All kept and green as a regression floor; v2 checks are added beside them.
All deleted; the testbench restarts from fixtures and lib.

questions.answer: kept only where they cover a kept leaf or hook; suites for retired nodes deleted; the test-builder writes v2's checks into the run's checks folder and may reuse fixtures and lib
